name: Stripe
tagline: Practical rounds: real code, real bugs, real APIs

values.name: Users first
values.meaning: Start from user needs and talk to users directly.

values.name: Create with craft and beauty
values.meaning: Careful, elegant work shows care for users.

values.name: Move with urgency and focus
values.meaning: Act fast on what matters most.

values.name: Collaborate egolessly
values.meaning: Share openly, debate ideas, give credit.

values.name: Stay curious
values.meaning: Keep learning how businesses and the economy work.

values.name: Obsess over talent
values.meaning: Everyone helps keep the hiring bar high.

loop.focus: Practical coding problem with growing requirements in your own IDE.
Clean, working code for a realistic task, not a puzzle.
Find and fix bugs in an unfamiliar codebase using its tests.
Build a small feature from API docs, e.g. calling a REST service.
Past experience measured against the operating principles.

coding_style: Practical, real-world tasks where your code actually runs, often in your own IDE or CoderPad. Graded on correct working code, readability, decision-making, and methodical debugging and testing. Requirements usually build in parts, so structure that can be extended matters more than clever algorithms.
question_themes: Process a stream of payment events into per-payment state
Mask card numbers in log lines
Fix a failing test in an open source library
Call a REST API and combine responses

panel_flavor.manager: Maya checks your stories against users first and urgency, and asks what you would cut to ship sooner.
panel_flavor.tech: Theo hands you a real codebase or API doc, lets you run code, and watches how you navigate, test, and extend it.
panel_flavor.skeptic: Sol wants evidence you tested a hypothesis before changing code, and asks how you know a fix works.

uncertain: Intern and new grad loops may drop rounds; public detail is mainly for experienced hires
Whether all candidates get both bug squash and integration rounds
Reports of an AI-assisted coding round in 2026 loops
